You are an expert programmer working in a language based on lambda calculus.
Your goal is to write programs that accomplish the tasks specified by the user.
This is a domain-specific language for regular expressions that specify string transformations.

Write programs using the available functions:

regex_not :: tsubstr -> tsubstr

regex_or :: tsubstr -> tsubstr -> tsubstr

regex_concat :: tsubstr -> tsubstr -> tsubstr

regex_match :: tsubstr -> tsubstr -> bool

regex_split :: tsubstr -> tfullstr -> list(tsubstr)

regex_flatten :: list(tsubstr) -> tfullstr

regex_tail :: list(tsubstr) -> tsubstr

regex_append :: t0 -> list(t0) -> list(t0)

regex_reverse_cdr :: list(t0) -> list(t0)

regex_if :: bool -> t0 -> t0 -> t0

regex_cons :: t0 -> list(t0) -> list(t0)

regex_car :: list(t0) -> t0

regex_cdr :: list(t0) -> list(t0)

regex_map :: (t0 -> t1) -> list(t0) -> list(t1)

replace_if_match :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_map (lambda (regex_if (regex_match $1 $0) $2 $0)) (regex_split '.' $2))))))
description: A function that replaces a substring in a full string if a match is found based on a given condition.

replace_first_letter :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_cons $0 (regex_cdr (regex_split '.' $1))))))
description: A function that replaces the first letter of a full string with a specified substring.

replace_end_with_substring :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_append $0 (regex_reverse_cdr (regex_split '.' $1))))))
description: A function that replaces the end of a full string with a specified substring.

replace_with_transform :: tfullstr -> (tsubstr -> tsubstr) -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_map $0 (regex_split '.' $1)))))
description: A function that replaces substrings in a full string based on a transformation function applied to each substring.

replace_if_p_found :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_map (lambda (regex_if (regex_match 'p' $0) $1 $0)) (regex_split empty_string $1)))))
description: A function that replaces occurrences of 'p' with a specified substring in a full string.

replace_if_match_with_concatenated_suffix :: tsubstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (lambda (replace_if_match $0 (regex_concat 'a' $1) $2))))
description: A function that replaces a substring in a full string with a concatenated suffix if a match is found based on a given condition.

replace_first_letter_with_suffix :: tsubstr -> tfullstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (replace_first_letter $0 (regex_concat $1 'a'))))
description: A function that replaces the first letter of a full string with a specified substring concatenated as a suffix.

append_split_empty :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_append $0 (regex_split empty_string $1)))))
description: A function that appends the first argument to the full string after splitting the second argument by an empty string.

replace_if_match_with_condition :: tsubstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (lambda (replace_with_transform $0 (lambda (regex_if (regex_match $0 $2) $3 $0))))))
description: A function that replaces a substring in a full string based on a condition specified by a transformation function.

replace_if_match_with_concatenated_character :: tsubstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (lambda (replace_if_match $0 (regex_concat 'c' $1) $2))))
description: A function that replaces a substring in a full string with a concatenated character if a match is found based on a given condition.
